---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new tool, integration, or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem / Use Case

A clear description of the problem you're solving or the use case this enables.

Example: "As an analyst, I want to [do X] so that [I can achieve Y]."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you'd like. If it's a new MCP tool, describe:
- Tool name
- Input parameters
- Expected output
- Which SkyFi API endpoint it uses

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you've thought about.

## Additional Context

Links to relevant SkyFi API docs, MCP spec sections, or examples.
